title: Meridian depot photos
author: Siti Nuraini
text: Nandini sent the depot photos but the attachment order is reversed. The blue ramp is the inbound side. I put captions in the shared album so Yuki does not have to guess from the forklift direction.

title: Sakura workshop room
author: Daniel Lim
text: The customer moved our workshop to floor 6. Visitor reception still has floor 4 on the calendar. Miki will meet us by the lift; the loading bay entrance is only for warehouse staff.

title: Meridian invoice contact
author: Arjun Desai
text: Nandini is the warehouse sponsor, not the accounts-payable contact. Please address invoice questions to Devika. I have corrected the CRM contact label; the signed order form was already right.

title: Case study quote attribution
author: Farah Khan
text: The quote about fewer phone calls came from Sakura's shift supervisor, not their CIO. The customer marked the attribution on page two. The marketing draft now shows the supervisor's approved title.

title: Sakura training attendance
author: Siti Nuraini
text: Eight supervisors attended the second session. Two watched from one laptop, which explains the meeting attendance count of seven. Miki has the recording link and the annotated keyboard shortcuts.

title: Meridian pilot vocabulary
author: Arjun Desai
text: The customer says consignment where our UI says shipment. Their pilot spreadsheet uses both. Daniel's workshop glossary has the mapping, including the one-to-many relation to cartons.

title: Quarter close time zones
author: Nur Aziz
text: The ledger export is stamped UTC while the finance sheet displays Singapore time. The two rows near midnight refer to the same shipment. There is no extra shipment to bill.

title: Preview screenshots for translation
author: Farah Khan
text: The translator needs the strings in a table, not burned into screenshots. Yuki's export has string keys and a notes column for warehouse vocabulary. The Japanese line breaks are still under review.

title: Ravi support handover
author: Amina Yusuf
text: Ravi Perera finishes today. Siti has the night-queue checklist and Daniel has the open Sakura training thread. The support alias still reaches the current team; Ravi's individual mailbox is no longer an escalation route.

title: Kestrel signing-key notice
author: Chen Wei
text:
Chen Wei: Kestrel now expires request signing keys eight hours after issue.
The old key remains visible in their portal but no longer validates a replay. Their support person confirmed this is live, not a staging flag.

title: Meridian workshop whiteboard
author: Daniel Lim
text: I typed up the whiteboard while the marker colours were still legible. The dotted arrows are customer questions, not implemented integration paths. The photo and transcription are side by side in the workshop folder.

title: Sakura production enablement date
author: Siti Nuraini
text:
We will switch your Route Lens tenant to general availability on 15 April, with the standard production SLA.
Hi Miki, the screenshots from your preview look good. I reused the launch note from the enablement folder. Please send the list of warehouse admins by Tuesday.

title: Meridian renewal: Route Lens line item
author: Arjun Desai
text:
Your new Route Lens subscription will be USD 99 per workspace per month when you sign next week.
Hi Nandini, I have attached the revised seat counts. There is no existing Route Lens order form on your account, so we can bundle this with the renewal. Thanks for waiting while I was at the depot.

title: Launch day screen recording
author: Farah Khan
text: The recording has a cursor hovering over the route chip for half a minute. I trimmed that pause in the internal cut. Siti's customer walkthrough still has the full interaction for training.

title: Anika departure and ownership handoff
author: Amina Yusuf
text: Today is Anika Rao's last day at Northwind Labs. Platform ownership moves to Mei Tan; connector questions go to Chen Wei. Her historical notes stay in the archive. Please do not route new approvals to Anika's address. The farewell lunch receipts go to the usual expense folder.

title: Sakura summer roster
author: Siti Nuraini
text: Miki is away next week. Her deputy has the training recording and knows where the incident notice archive lives. There is no change to the tenant's support contacts in the product.

title: Invoice download reassurance
author: Nur Aziz
text: Meridian compared a fresh download with last month's PDF and the totals match. The difference they saw was the filename date, not a recalculated exchange rate. Devika confirmed the reconciliation is closed.

title: Demo laptop checklist
author: Daniel Lim
text: The demo laptop has the fabricated Osaka tenant bookmarked. The browser zoom is back at 100 percent and the projector adapter is in the sleeve. The recording from the last rehearsal is in the team folder.
